title: Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow II
summary: Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow is a mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. It is unlocked by 2 or 3 missions, depending on the order in which they are completed: * If the player completes "Favored Sons" first, and "The Delights of Van Horn" second, then "Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow" appears; * If the player completes "The Delights of Van Horn" first, and "Favored Sons" second, then "The Bridge to Nowhere" blocks the appearance of "Mrs. Sadie Adler, Widow" until it is completed as well.

title: The Bridge to Nowhere
summary: John and Arthur plant dynamite on the Bacchus Bridge in order to create a distraction and disrupt the army's transportation.

goldRequirements.label: Plant the dynamite within 1 minute and 35 seconds.
Escape the oncoming train within 19 seconds.

title: My Last Boy
summary: Eagle Flies rides into Beaver Hollow to rally a war party for the final raid on Cornwall Kerosene & Tar. Against his father, Chief Rains Fall's wishes. Dutch and the gang then accompany Eagle Flies into battle against the U.S. Army.

goldRequirements.label: Save Paytah.
After crossing over the train that shows up with the Gatling Gun, Paytah will be seen struggling with a soldier near a train car to the left. Kill the soldier to accomplish this objective.
Get 30 headshots.
Complete with at least 80% accuracy.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

title: Our Best Selves
summary: As their final job, the gang ride to Saint Denis to intercept and rob a train carrying army supplies and payroll, headed for the recently destroyed Bacchus Bridge.

goldRequirements.label: Get a headshot in Dead Eye after jumping from Dutch's horse.
After Arthur jumps onto the train from The Count, a soldier will shoot John off the train. Headshot this soldier to complete the objective.
Complete within 11 minutes.
Fight through the train with at least 80% accuracy.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

title: Red Dead Redemption
summary: With John assumed dead, and Abigail captured by Pinkertons, Dutch cuts them loose, and rides for Beaver Hollow. Arthur and Sadie head to Van Horn to rescue Abigail.

goldRequirements.label: Get 7 headshots while covering Sadie from the lighthouse.
After Sadie is captured, reach Abigail and Sadie within 1 minute.
Complete with at least 70% accuracy.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

title: The Course of True Love IV
summary: At Beaver Hollow, Arthur receives a letter from Penelope Braithwaite.

title: The Course of True Love V
summary: Arthur tries to help Penelope Braithwaite and Beau Gray escape their families once and for all.

goldRequirements.label: Headshot 5 of the Braithwaites as they pursue the train.
Complete within 7 minutes and 30 seconds.

title: Money Lending and Other Sins VI
missableWarning: Finish during chapter 6 if you do not want to miss it
summary: Leopold Strauss wants the player to collect two debts, one from J. John Weathers and another from Arthur Londonderry.

title: Money Lending and Other Sins VII
missableWarning: Finish during chapter 6 if you do not want to miss it
summary: Leopold Strauss wants the player to collect two debts, one from J. John Weathers and another from Arthur Londonderry.

title: Do Not Seek Absolution I
missableWarning: Finish during chapter 6 if you do not want to miss it
summary: Edith Downes tells Arthur that her son, Archie, is working at the Annesburg Mine. Arthur heads to the mine, to find Archie being goaded by the foreman, Mr. Dockery.

goldRequirements.label: Complete within 1 minute and 20 seconds.

title: Do Not Seek Absolution II
missableWarning: Finish during chapter 6 if you do not want to miss it
summary: Unwilling to accept Arthur's money, Edith Downes continues to sell her body. Worried for his mother's safety, Archie Downes asks Arthur to head to Willard's Rest to look for her.

goldRequirements.label: Find Edith Downes within 1 minute and 10 seconds.

title: Of Men and Angels I
missableWarning: Finish during chapter 6 if you do not want to miss it
summary: Of Men and Angels is a Strangers mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. The quest becomes available during Chapter 5 or 6. It has to be played prior to Trelawny's mission "The Fine Art of Conversation" or it will become unavailable after that.

title: Of Men and Angels II

summary: Of Men and Angels is a Strangers mission in Red Dead Redemption 2. The quest becomes available during Chapter 5 or 6. It has to be played prior to Trelawny's mission "The Fine Art of Conversation" or it will become unavailable after that.

title: The Wheel
summary: Several years after fleeing Dutch and the gang, John, Abigail and Jack look for work in the town of Strawberry.

goldRequirements.label: Reach Pronghorn Ranch without dropping any supplies.
Reclaim the wagon within 1 minute.

objectives.label: Go to the Doctor's Office to meet with Abigail
Deliver the goods to Pronghorn Ranch
Return the wagon to Pronghorn Ranch

title: Simple Pleasures
summary: Using the pseudonym "Jim Milton," John has secured a job as a hand at Pronghorn Ranch, and gets to work.

goldRequirements.label: When milking, fill a bucket within 10 seconds.
Complete within 5 minutes and 15 seconds.

objectives.label: Go to the house to speak with Abigail

title: Farming, For Beginners
summary: John works a day at the ranch, helping to build a fence, and looking after livestock.

goldRequirements.label: Fix the first section of fence in 1 minute and 30 seconds.
Avoid being hit by the bull.

objectives.label: Investigate the commotion at the corral
Take the bull to the barn

title: Fatherhood, For Beginners
summary: With the other ranch hands busy, and Geddes heading in to town, John takes on more work on the ranch.

goldRequirements.label: Tire out Jeremiah within 45 seconds.
Feed Jeremiah a treat.
Teach Jack to ride without his horse bucking him off.
Win the race back to Pronghorn Ranch.

title: Old Habits
summary: A gang of hired-guns cause trouble on Pronghorn Ranch.

goldRequirements.label: Defeat the Laramie without taking a hit.
Defeat the Laramie within 25 seconds.

title: Fatherhood, For Idiots
summary: John juggles fatherhood and his multiple identities as he heads to Strawberry with Jack to collect mail for Geddes, and a package for Abigail.

goldRequirements.label: Kill all 3 enemies in Dead Eye.
After the confrontation, return to Pronghorn Ranch within 1 minute and 30 seconds.

title: Jim Milton Rides, Again?
summary: John is thanked by Mr. Geddes for his help with the Laramie Gang, and John turns in for the night, only to be woken by a raid on the ranch.

goldRequirements.label: Get 10 kills while dual wielding sidearms.
Get 15 headshots.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

title: Motherhood
summary: John receives a telegram from Sadie Adler.

goldRequirements.label: Complete within 1 minute 30 seconds.

title: Gainful Employment
summary: After receiving a telegram from Sadie Adler, John Marston meets her in Valentine and helps her with some bounty hunting work.

goldRequirements.label: After arriving in Strawberry, locate the bounty within 30 seconds.
After mounting your horse, catch and hogtie the bounty within 1 minute and 15 seconds.

title: The Landowning Classes
summary: Mr. Geddes gave a credit reference to use at the bank in Blackwater.

title: Home of the Gentry?
summary: Before he can purchase Beecher's Hope, John must inspect the land and move on any illegal tenants. Back in Blackwater, he runs into an old friend.

goldRequirements.label: Complete within 2 minutes and 30 seconds.

title: Bare Knuckle Friendships
summary: Uncle tells John that he has heard that Charles Smith is alive and in Saint Denis. John and Uncle go to Saint Denis to track him down.

goldRequirements.label: After arriving in Saint Denis, find Charles within 1 minute and 50 seconds.
Kill all of Guido Martelli’s men within 10 seconds.

title: An Honest Day's Labors
summary: John meets Sadie in Blackwater. Sadie asks John to help her recover a bounty named Shane Finley who was taken from her by a professional rival, James Langton.

goldRequirements.label: Kill all of Langton’s men during the horseback escape.
After choosing your approach, escape with Shane Finley within 5 minutes.
Complete with at least 70% accuracy.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

title: Home Improvement for Beginners
summary: John, Uncle and Charles tear down the derelict shack at Beecher's Hope.

goldRequirements.label: Complete within 18 seconds.

title: The Tool Box
summary: John purchases a pre-cut house from the Blackwater lumberyard. Hearing the Skinner Brothers are in the area, John, Charles, and two hired guns bring the lumber home via the toolmaker at Manzanita Post.

goldRequirements.label: Headshot all Skinner Brothers hiding up trees.
Find Mr. Wayne within 2 minutes and 15 seconds.
Complete using only sidearms.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

title: A New Jerusalem
summary: John puts together his pre-cut ranch house with the help of Charles and the encouragement of Uncle.

goldRequirements.label: Hammer the nails in with 80% accuracy.
Complete within 3 minutes and 35 seconds.

title: A Quick Favor for an Old Friend
summary: With his debts mounting and a barn to buy, John accompanies Sadie to hunt down the wanted criminal, Ramón Cortez, and bring him to justice.

goldRequirements.label: Force Cortez's men to flee from Rhodes within 30 seconds.
Get 5 headshots while covering Sadie with a long scoped rifle.
Get 4 hip fire kills.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

title: Uncle's Bad Day
summary: Uncle, John and Charles spend the night celebrating after finishing work on the barn. John and Charles wake to find that Uncle has been taken by the Skinner Brothers. The two must then find and rescue him from the extremely violent gang.

goldRequirements.label: Get 5 headshots using the bow.
After freeing Uncle, return to Beecher's Hope within 3 minutes and 10 seconds.
Complete with at least 80% accuracy.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

title: The Best of Women
summary: After months of separation, Jack and Abigail finally arrive at the ranch.

title: Trying Again
summary: John takes Jack fishing with the family dog, Rufus. They catch more than they bargained for.

goldRequirements.label: Catch a fish.
Complete within 5 minutes and 20 seconds.

title: A Really Big Bastard
summary: Sadie visits John at Beecher's Hope. They leave to hunt down a bounty, Marshall Thurwell, in Tall Trees and discuss other men who have evaded their capture.

goldRequirements.label: Shoot the bear 4 times as it charges.
Headshot both the rival bounty hunters in Dead Eye.
Complete within 7 minutes and 15 seconds.

title: A New Future Imagined
summary: John and Abigail go in to Blackwater to spend some quality time together. John has a question to ask her.

goldRequirements.label: Complete within 7 minutes and 30 seconds.

title: American Venom
summary: Sadie Adler hears that Micah Bell is alive somewhere. With the whereabouts of Cleet known in Strawberry, the gang saddles up looking for revenge.

goldRequirements.label: Help Sadie catch Cleet within 35 seconds.
Headshot the sniper who shoots Charles.
Complete with at least 85% accuracy.
Complete the mission without taking any health items.

objectives.label: Tie the noose round Cleet's neck.
Threaten Cleet by moving the lever.
Hang Cleet or leave him be.
